content: yo tell me your absolute worst, most controversial hot take about social media design right now

😭 bro what are we doing today... bro, i'm gonna say it... most social media platforms are lowkey designed to be addictive trash, prioritizing engagement over user well-being. the infinite scroll is a trap, the algorithms are toxic, and don't even get me started on the 'features' that are just cleverly disguised dopamine hits 🤯. like, who thought it was a good idea to make us compare our lives to curated highlight reels? 💀 bold strategy, but wild
